utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, the repair drive—sounds like tools and helping sort donations. Remind me what you still need, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive and pass along the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—thanks, Vik. I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, so just send me the latest when you can and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it — I’ll pull together the repair list and check who’s available to help, then send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — please put the front gate latch and porch light first, and let me know if you need any location details from me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’ll put the front gate latch and porch light at the top, and I’ll reach out if I need any more location details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s still on, and I’ll keep everyone updated so folks can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep me posted, and I’ll jump in if I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted, and thanks for being willing to help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — if you hear anything on the drill, let me know. I’ll still come by at 6:30 with the screwdriver and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the drill. See you at 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s coming along, but we’re still short on a few supplies. I’m keeping a running list so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—can you confirm the repair drive is still on, even with the missing supplies? I just want to make sure we’re still moving ahead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still on—we’re just filling the gaps as we go. I’m keeping the list updated so we can keep moving ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely, Gus—more hands will make the repair drive go smoother. I’m sure we’ll find something useful for you to jump in on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Tess—I'm still in, and I’ll be there to help sort tools. Just point me to whatever needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Gus—just come by and I’ll put you right to work sorting the tools. We’re going to get a lot done with everyone pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure—send me the time slots and the repair list, and I’ll help line up volunteers around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — I’ll check the start time and send over the time slots and repair list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—once you send them, I’ll slot everything around pickup and school hours.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 10 with the drill, screwdrivers, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, good — 10 works for me if we’ve got the route and load plan sorted. I’m still a bit worried about timing, so let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re set on my end — just bring the route plan and your notes, and we’ll keep it on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. If you still need an extra pair of hands, I can come by and help out; just remind me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I could use help with the porch step and the loose gate, if you’re still willing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, absolutely — I’m still willing. Just point me to the porch step and the loose gate, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m not sure what’s left yet. If I catch any supply updates, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a big help. Just let me know if you hear what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m set for Saturday at 9 at the garage. Just let me know if you need me to bring anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Leo — 10 AM at the garage works, and if you can bring a drill, some screwdrivers, and a few work gloves, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be there at 10 with a drill, screwdrivers, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we need to bring anything else for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — if you can bring any basic tools, spare screws, and a few cleaning supplies, that would help a lot. It’s now on Sunday at the community center, so we’re set there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can bring those. Do you still want me there at 10 AM?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll bring the screwdriver and help sort donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Dane. I’ll confirm whether we’re still starting at 9 a.m. and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — just let me know about the 9 a.m. start, and I’ll be there with the screwdriver ready to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on — Rosa already has the front gate latch and porch light at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm you’re definitely coming too? I just want to make sure we’re all on the same page about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking—it's still 10 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s still 10 AM, and I’ll double-check the timing once I’ve confirmed everything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair list and helper availability together, then send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Mara — send it when you can, and I’ll take a look right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put it together and send it over shortly, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That still works for me — if we’re doing 6:30, just send me the route and I’ll be there to help load things up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, 6:30 works for me too — I’ll send the route and keep an eye out for any supply updates.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do, Bo — I’ll text you the time and place as soon as I have it. Thanks again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just text me the time and place when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Absolutely — I’ll send it over as soon as I have the details. Thanks, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the latest details before I confirm anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem—I’m still in, and I can wait on the final details before locking in tools or timing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll hold off until the final details are in before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send the item list over soon and keep coordinating helpers for Saturday after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, send it when you can—I’ll keep tracking the supplies and check off the boxes and tape first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll send it over soon and keep the Saturday helper list moving. Thanks for staying on the supplies—boxes and tape first sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful—looks like we’re getting a solid little crew together. I’ll be there to point everyone to whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Tess — thank you. I’ll meet everyone Sunday at the community center and we’ll get started by directing folks to the first repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds great, Rosa—I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know to head to the community center Sunday. We should have a nice turnout for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands, and I’ll text you the time and drop-off spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Ira — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep my phone nearby and try not to misplace my toolkit again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the details while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—10 AM works, and I’ll spread the word; if you’re coming, please bring your drill, screwdrivers, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll bring my drill, screwdrivers, and gloves. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thanks, Rey! I’ll keep letting folks know so we’ve got a good crew at 10.
